# KiddoKompas

> KiddoKompas is a catalog of kids’ activities in Novi Sad — schools, clubs and workshops filtered by age, neighborhood and interest. Serbian is the default language. English lives under `/en`.

KiddoKompas helps parents find sports, dance and other programs in one place. Catalog information is for guidance; schedules, prices and group availability should be confirmed with each school. Contact: info@kiddokompas.rs

## Pages

- [Home](https://kiddokompas.rs/): Serbian homepage and category overview
- [Search](https://kiddokompas.rs/pretraga): Filtered search results
- [Map](https://kiddokompas.rs/mapa): Map of schools and clubs
- [About](https://kiddokompas.rs/o-nama): About KiddoKompas
- [Privacy policy](https://kiddokompas.rs/politika-privatnosti): Privacy policy
